notes:
MusicPort: recovers by itself after a lost connection or a server restart, and no longer stays on "Loading..." after you turn a room on.
CasaNova: "Clear queue" is now in the room menu on phones, and choosing a playlist no longer starts it twice.
Calm Radio: channel lists open much faster, and the server no longer stops responding after many Calm Radio plays.
AirPlay: a speaker added while a track is playing now starts straight away instead of at the next track.
